reserveReview.rationale: Re-reviewed 2026-08-29. Aster documents asUSDF as the yield-bearing token received by staking USDF, with NAV set by the strategies backing USDF. At BNB Chain block 118819303 (hash 0xf3d8b1d6d144998ddd1f31562c07bda0b1614ef685a63b3ce01837001f621ac5; 2026-08-29T18:56:38Z), public RPC eth_call reads on asUSDFEarn 0xdb57a53c428a9fafcbfeffb6dd80d0f427543695 returned USDF() = 0x5a110fC00474038f6c02E89C707D638602EA44B5 and asUSDF() = 0x917AF46B3C3c6e1Bb7286B9F59637Fb7C65851Fb; USDF.balanceOf(asUSDFEarn) was 2,960,981.376879277 and asUSDF.totalSupply() was 2,778,084.534595421, with exchangePrice() = 1.065834078079115961. The verified wrapper source transfers deposited USDF into asUSDFEarn before minting calculated asUSDF shares, so the direct reserve is one 100% USDF wrapper position. The row links the tracked usdf-astherus parent; its upstream USDT custody and delta-neutral strategy exposures are inherited and not duplicated here.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: At the asUSDF layer there is no legal custodian or holder-claim structure: deposited USDF sits in the asUSDFEarn wrapper contract, whose admin (a 4-of-8 Safe acting through a six-hour timelock, verified at BSC blocks 110184782/110184820) can upgrade wrapper logic and whose ADMIN_ROLE can pause transfers. Aster documents that upstream USDT is transferred to Aster's Ceffu custodial account and deployed into delta-neutral positions, which is documented asset reuse rather than segregation, hence rehypothecation permitted at the upstream layer; Ceffu account terms, venue-level segregation, bankruptcy treatment, and provider shares are unpublished. asUSDF-to-USDF withdrawal is documented at T+1 hour (two hours); upstream USDF-to-USDT redemption takes 1-2 days standard and up to 7 days for large amounts per the FAQ.
